_comment: Governing law, venue and supervisory authority per jurisdiction and language. Written so they fit after 'pravom ...' (genitive governing), and as noun phrases for venue and authority. Used when the site sets law.jurisdiction and does not set law.governing/venue/authority itself. A missing language falls back to en.
